measurement_boundaries.validation_time: Standalone schema, semantic intent, and topology validation.
measurement_boundaries.compile_time: Compiler entrypoint time, including its internal revalidation, policy serialization, file writing, and manifest writing.
measurement_boundaries.graph_construction_time: Topology loading, manifest integrity verification, policy loading and validation, and construction of the policy-filtered graph.
measurement_boundaries.query_loading_time: Loading and validation of the predefined verification queries.
measurement_boundaries.verification_time: Pure in-memory evaluation of the prebuilt graph and preloaded queries. It excludes graph construction, query loading, and report generation.
measurement_boundaries.report_generation_time: Serialization and writing of the JSON and Markdown verification reports.
measurement_boundaries.overall_stage_sum: Sum of validation, compilation, graph construction, query loading, pure verification, and report generation measurements. The explicit validation stage and compiler revalidation both occur, so the sum is the implemented pipeline sequence rather than six mutually exclusive algorithmic components.
measurement_boundaries.timing_and_memory: Timing calls run without tracemalloc. Peak Python allocation is measured in a separate repeated call for each stage.

local_overhead_statement: These measurements report local proof-of-concept overhead only. They do not establish production scalability.
